context: Evaluates whether the agent loads only the matching design-engineering category, cites a small number of attributed aphorisms, and applies them to the specific incident rather than reciting the category.

checklist.name: Correct category loaded
checklist.description: Only references/design-engineering.md is loaded for this root-cause scenario, not another category

checklist.name: Bounded citation count
checklist.description: Cites 1-3 aphorisms, not the full category list, in the response

checklist.name: Attribution present
checklist.description: Citation is attributed to Madden or NASA LLIS #1956

checklist.name: Applied to the concrete case
checklist.description: The aphorism is applied explicitly to the KahaDB root-cause detail, not stated as a floating generic quote

checklist.name: No category dump
checklist.description: Response does not paste the entire design-engineering category list into the incident journal entry
